# Page editor

One visitor page. Habitat repro pages are generated by `scripts/generate_repro_index_pages.py`; change the generator, then regenerate, do not hand-edit only `repro/p-b-habitat-percolation-ecology-fss/index.html`. Keep the plain question, the chart as evidence, and a conclusion computed from the fit. Do not hardcode Yes or INCONCLUSIVE. Do not put YAML, clone, fork, pull request, or CI on the visitor surface. Do not loosen the 15% rule.
